# ffxf_ssh_key (Resource)

Registers and manages an SSH public key. Key name and public key changes replace the registered key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    ffxf = {
      source = "ffxfnet/ffxf"
    }
  }
}

provider "ffxf" {}

resource "ffxf_ssh_key" "work" {
  name       = "work"
  public_key = "ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIExamplePublicKey user@example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name for this SSH key.
- `public_key` (String) SSH public-key material. This is a public key, not a private secret.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) UTC time when the key was registered.
- `fingerprint` (String) Fingerprint assigned to the key.
- `id` (Number) Numeric SSH-key identifier.
